Verdict GO with one structural correction and six gates; D-CL26..29 ratified. Key evidence: SPEC-3 already ships ObjectClass::{Shard,Tile,Asset} and SPEC-5 already has snapshot_manifest_id, so the authorization and checkpoint layers anticipated the observation plane; floats are structurally banned from signed bytes so hexon interiors must stay opaque sealed blobs; SPEC-7 previews are content-agnostic and §7.1.4 MANDATES the dual live/durable path; iot_reading and a tested GeoParquet writer already exist to graduate from. Highest-severity finding: unknown operation kinds replicate verse-wide with zero version-gating into a single reason-blind quarantine pool, so a high-volume new kind starves un-upgraded peers legitimate backlog — correctness-safe, availability-hostile, and free to fix only until CandidateVerifier is implemented (G1). Owner overrode two recommendations: peer N-of-M replication is in scope now (D-CL27, enters as SPEC-9 design phase, not a code wave) and the work folds into Workstream G rather than sibling tracks (D-CL29, roughly tripling remaining scope).
